arabic: قَالَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: لَا تَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أَوَلَا أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُمْ؟ أَفْشُوا السَّلَامَ بَيْنَكُمْ.
transliteration: Laa tadkhuloonal-jannata hattaa tu'minoo, wa laa tu'minoo hattaa tahaabboo, awalaa adullukum 'alaa shay'in ithaa fa'altumoohu tahaababtum? Afshus-salaama baynakum.
translation: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'You will not enter Paradise until you believe, and you will not believe until you love one another. Shall I not guide you to something that if you do it, you will love one another? Spread the greeting of peace among yourselves.'
